task.description:

- Add entry: "fix(ISS-0125): ON DELETE CASCADE FK constraint + cleanup hardening for instance_definition_snapshots"
- Reference GitHub #391 and the migration 1106_iss0125_instance_definition_snapshots_cascade.sql
- Include: 'Fixes C23503 errors in 43 integration test runs caused by FK constraint ordering.'

Update requirement status (if applicable):

- git commit -m "chore(ISS-0125): update documentation and requirement status"
- git push origin feature/{run_id}

Complete the handoff with PASS if all updates committed successfully.
